# Retained source credit

`pr5496-join.py`, `pr5496-PROOF.md` and `pr5496-README.md` are byte-identical
copies from JoyboyBrian's PR #5496 at
`a99afd7e0024af8367d5a2f6f4d2da57a1d13dd5`, under the repository's
Apache-2.0 license. VENDORED.json records original paths, Git blobs and
SHA256. Their original authorship and AI-assistance notices are retained.
They are audited inputs, not new implementation by this package.

The implementation's inherited credits include Ali Romman (#5353),
Hiroki KUMAZAKI, Cinna Davis (#4100), ToikY, Tekalign, Jose Manuel,
Ryanson Jonathan, unpaidmoon, Douglas Colkitt and John-Michael Smith.
Their algorithms and proofs are explicit premises of this scoped audit.
No pending Git object is needed for replay: the audited bytes are here.
